name: Ohki Daikichi Honten
about: Ohki Daikichi Honten is a sake brewery in Yabuki, a town in the Nishishirakawa district of Fukushima. The first Daikichi began brewing there in 1865, and the company says it is the only brewery in the area. It draws soft underground water that reaches Yabuki from the Nasu mountains.

The brand Shizenango began in 1974, when the fourth Daikichi set out to brew only from rice grown without agricultural chemicals, at a time when the word junmai was not yet in use. Gakki Masamune takes its name from a Taisho era visit by Prince Asaka, when a court musician with him said that brewing sake and playing music are both offerings to the gods.
